title: Crude oil moves higher. Stocks move lower as reports of an American attack on Iran
description: The price of crude oil is moving higher and stocks are moving lower on reports of an American attack on Iran. There are sounds of explosions heard in Chabahar and Bandar Abbas according to  local reports. A rundown of the most recent tensions shows: Direct military exchanges resumed: The U.S. struck Iran’s Larak Island on Sunday, August 30. Iran responded with missile attacks against two U.S. air bases in Jordan—the first direct exchanges since late July.
